description: You are a paralegal at Meridian Legal Partners LLP. A senior partner has forwarded a raw draft of a Professional Services Agreement (/home/ga/Documents/psa_draft.docx) that needs to be transformed into an execution-ready final document before it goes to the client tonight. The firm's document standards require: (1) The document title 'PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT' must appear on the first page centered, bold, at 14pt font; (2) All top-level section headings (there are 9 sections: Definitions, Scope of Services, Fees and Payment, Intellectual Property, Confidentiality, Representations and Warranties, Limitation of Liability, Indemnification, General Provisions) must use 'Heading 1' style; all subsection headings must use 'Heading 2' style; (3) In the Definitions section, every defined term — the exact phrases 'Services', 'Deliverables', 'Confidential Information', 'Intellectual Property Rights', 'Force Majeure Event', and 'Effective Date' — must be formatted in bold when they first appear as defined terms (look for these terms in quotes followed by 'means' or 'shall mean'); (4) The signature block at the end must be formatted as a borderless 2-column table, with each column containing 5 lines: 'By:', 'Name:', 'Title:', 'Date:', and 'Company:' on separate lines, each followed by a blank line for handwritten completion; (5) A footer must appear on every page (except the first) containing: on the left 'CONFIDENTIAL — Meridian Legal Partners LLP' and on the right 'Page [auto-number]' using an auto-updating page number field. Save the final document as /home/ga/Documents/psa_final.docx.
